content: {"praised":["Lecy Goranson's return as Becky was welcomed.","Guest stars added variety to the season.","Humorous parody scenes were entertaining.","Season included wacky Halloween episode with baby birth.","Shelley Winters guest appearance was brilliant."],"criticized":["Season 8 was boring and unimaginative.","Episodes became absurd with fantasy interludes.","Too many real-life references distracted from story.","Sarah Chalke's Becky was weak and annoying.","Negative portrayal of mobile homes offended viewers."]}
